$comment: The one place that pins the catalog sources (ADR 0059). `npm run snapshot` (network) runs the pinned UI8Kit CLI in a clean Svelte project (every kit primitive, lib and utils item, the theme items, the components the app chrome imports and only the blocks listed here), pins the published variants, props, contracts and models of those blocks, and copies the generated prototypes (wireframes) of ui8kit/prototypes at the pinned commit. `npm run snapshot:check` is offline. Never edit the generated files by hand.
